<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: Echo Med Lab''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス：エコー基地医務室</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">1ターンに1回、自分の医療用ドロイドを1台、-2で配備できる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しており、この場所に帝国軍がいるなら、フォース消耗に＋1。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Hoth-Echo-Med-Lab-PSA-82917279.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: Echo Med Lab.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' English reduces one medical droid's deploy cost by 2.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
